title: Argentinian Beef Skewers
description: Tender beef skewers marinated in a smoky Argentinian-inspired sauce, grilled to perfection in the oven.
instructions: Thread beef pieces onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
In a large bowl, whisk together chimichurri sauce, smoked paprika, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper.
Add the beef skewers to the marinade and toss to coat.
Let the skewers marinate for at least 30 minutes, or up to 2 hours in the refrigerator.
Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil and brush with olive oil.
Place the skewers on the prepared baking sheet and bake for 12-15 minutes, or until cooked to desired level of doneness.
Remove the skewers from the oven and let rest for 5 minutes.
Serve hot with lime wedges and garnish with cilantro, if desired.
